end.summary:
Practised factorising x² + px + q by finding two numbers with the required sum and product.
Completed 6 attempts, with 4 unaided correct.
Practised taking out a common factor; both attempts were correct.
Initially copied coefficients in (x + 5)(x + 6), then corrected this by multiplying to verify and using sum/product.
Teach-back was not yet passed.
end.parentNote: Arjun practised finding two numbers whose sum and product match the middle and constant terms, then writing the factors. They also practised taking out a common factor, including 6x + 9 = 3(2x + 3). A mix-up between copying coefficients and checking sum/product was corrected later by multiplying out and verifying. At home, ask Arjun to factorise a few expressions and check each answer by expanding the brackets.
